title: Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $γ$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.

AI.tldr: ALBUM通过不等式约束实现无目标网络的离线RL训练，参数最少且内存占用最低
AI.translated_summary: 离线强化学习通常通过最小化回归损失来训练critic，目标是通过带有指数移动平均(EMA)更新的目标网络稳定的bootstrap值目标。多步目标包含行为策略动作，因此需要off-policy校正。我们通过不等式约束在样本内强制执行critic的Bellman最优性。我们提出了提升贝尔曼线性规划(LBLP)，它将贝尔曼最优性的线性规划特征提升到联合(Q,V)空间，使每个约束仅涉及数据集中的状态-动作对。其唯一最小值是样本内最优对，而沿数据集轨迹K步段的约束对于任何rollout策略和horizon保持此最小值不变。在确定性动力学下，该最小值位于最佳数据集回报和最优值之间。将约束松弛为hinge penalties在表格情况下会在有限惩罚系数以上恢复相同解。近似提升贝尔曼无约束最小化(ALBUM)使用神经网络实现此松弛，并通过stop gradient断开K步rollout目标。其目标不包含对bootstrap目标的平方回归，因此可以无需目标网络或EMA更新进行训练。在确定性动力学下，LBLP解是detach更新在独立于γ和K的系数条件下的驻点，不等式约束允许数据集轨迹上的折扣回报作为下界，无需off-policy校正或action chunking。在OGBench上，ALBUM使用单个带有高斯策略的critic，匹配FQL的平均性能，并与最近的action-chunking方法相当，同时使用所有比较方法中最少的参数和最低的峰值GPU内存。
AI.research_problem: 离线RL传统方法依赖目标网络和EMA更新来稳定bootstrap目标，且多步目标需要off-policy校正，需要更简洁的训练方法。
AI.key_innovation: 提出Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP)和ALBUM算法，通过不等式约束在样本内强制Bellman最优性，无需目标网络或EMA更新。
AI.motivation: 传统离线RL训练critic需要目标网络和EMA来稳定bootstrap目标，且多步目标需要off-policy校正，作者希望简化训练过程。
AI.method: 提出Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP)和ALBUM算法。LBLP通过不等式约束在样本内强制Bellman最优性，将问题提升到联合(Q,V)空间。ALBUM将约束松弛为hinge penalties，用神经网络实现并detach K步rollout targets。
AI.experiments: 在OGBench上进行评估，使用单个critic和Gaussian策略，与FQL、action-chunking方法比较。
AI.result: ALBUM匹配FQL的平均性能，与action-chunking方法相当，使用最少参数和最低峰值GPU内存。
AI.conclusion: ALBUM提供无需目标网络或EMA更新的训练方法，在确定性动力学下有效，允许数据集轨迹上的折扣回报作为下界。
AI.limitations: 摘要明确提到"Under deterministic dynamics"，暗示在非确定性动力学下可能存在局限性。
